phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F2 Phase C5 — BPM6-to-ESA F2 Concept Bridge
official_concept: ESA F2 currency and deposits spans BPM6 functional categories. Other Investment F2 is residual; a complete bridge requires the F2 portions of Direct Investment, Other Investment and Reserve Assets where applicable.

direct_investment_F2.dataset_constraint_result: bop_item dimension size 0 for every one of the 14 sector×unit probes
direct_investment_F2.interpretation: The direct-investment F2 subinstrument is not disseminated in bop_iip6_q under this item code and is not treated as zero.

known_functional_components.components: Other-Investment F2 plus Reserve-Assets F2 only

interpretation: The earlier negative holder diagnostics from Other-Investment F2 plus Reserve-Assets F2 are not interpreted as negative currency positions because those functional components are incomplete without the Direct-Investment F2 subinstrument.
The 2996.07 million RON gap to QSA W1 total F2 remains unallocated. It is not labelled as F21 or Direct-Investment F2 because the required F2 breakdown is not published.
FA__D__FL is a composite direct-investment debt-instruments item and cannot be substituted for F2; it may contain currency and deposits together with other debt instruments.
The reserve-assets F2 component is directly observable and explains why BNR Other-Investment F2 alone was far below the QSA deposits component.
The public Eurostat/ECB route has recovered sector structure but not the final functional-category instrument bridge required to construct holder-specific ESA F2/F21.

public_source_boundary.BNR_note: BNR public external-sector publications and metadata expose Direct Investment primarily as equity and debt instruments and provide an interactive database, but no current public evidence was established here for a 2025 Direct-Investment currency-and-deposits subinstrument suitable for the RMD bridge.
public_source_boundary.rule: Do not infer unavailable direct-investment F2 from broad debt instruments, historical proportions, or the residual gap.

disposition.accounting_recovery_next_priority: F4 loans source-coverage and materialization screening
disposition.reopen_F21_when: A source with definitionally comparable Direct-Investment F2 subinstrument detail or an equivalent exact ESA/BPM6 bridge becomes available.
